headline: NDTV World Summit scheduled for October 22-23 with PM Modi participating
hook: Global leaders and PM Modi gather for summit
summary: The NDTV World Summit will convene on October 22-23 to discuss global geopolitics and economics under the theme 'A World Between Orders'. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to participate in the dialogue alongside international leaders and experts. The event will feature discussions on global policy, economic trends, and international relations. Indian retail investors should note that high-level geopolitical and economic dialogues rarely create immediate market movements, though they may shape long-term policy expectations.
why_it_matters: Policy discussions carry no direct impact on your portfolio.
